title: Date night · Friday 6 November
note: Real Amsterdam restaurants. Addresses, prices and booking details come from public guides and the Michelin Guide, read on 30 October 2026; each place links its source. Free tables were not checked in this recorded tour, and the pictures are illustrations, not the restaurants' own photos.

idea.title: Dinner date next Friday
idea.text:
Find a restaurant for a date next Friday, 6 November, around 19:30 in Amsterdam.

- We like **Japanese, French, Asian and Spanish** food
- Somewhere quiet enough to talk, about €50–90 a head
- Show me which ones still have a table, where they are on a map, and plenty of photos of the food and the room

agents.title: Find Japanese and French places
agents.text: Search for Japanese and French restaurants in Amsterdam that suit a date: price, the room, how to book, and a source for each.

agents.text: Search for other Asian and Spanish restaurants in Amsterdam that suit a date: price, the room, how to book, and a source for each.

places.name: Yamazato
places.about: Kaiseki in Hotel Okura: a menu of nine or ten courses, with sake pairing.
places.date: Guides suggest booking two to four weeks ahead.
places.aside: Over budget: the kaiseki menu starts at about €140 a head.

places.name: Hosokawa
places.about: Teppanyaki: the chef cooks on the iron plate in front of you.
places.date: Ask for seats at the plate; guides recommend booking for weekends.

places.name: Izakaya
places.about: Japanese small plates with South American touches, from a robata grill and a hibachi, made to share.
places.date: Lively; good if you like to share many small plates.

places.name: Bistro de la Mer
places.about: A seafood bistro with a Michelin star: oysters, lobster and the day's fish, all à la carte.
places.date: Guides say book three to four weeks ahead for Thursday to Saturday dinners.

places.name: Auberge
places.about: French cooking in a bistro room on the Albert Cuypstraat.
places.date: A bistro setting, easy to talk.

places.name: Café Garçon
places.about: A Parisian-style bistro, open from breakfast to the aperitif, with classic French dishes.
places.date: Cosy and small; sister of Brasserie Margaux.

places.name: Pata Negra
places.about: A busy tapas bar, open every day from noon until late.
places.date: Lively rather than quiet; the kitchen stays open late at weekends.

places.name: Sal Gorda
places.about: A Spanish restaurant in Oud-Zuid, with a terrace in the warmer months.
places.date: Quieter streets around it; good for a slow dinner.

places.name: Sagardi
places.about: A Basque grill and pintxos bar near the Singel and Dam Square.
places.date: Grilled steak to share; book online.

places.name: A-Fusion
places.about: Asian cooking in Chinatown, with a Michelin Bib Gourmand for good value.

places.name: Bird
places.about: A well-known Thai restaurant, with its own snack bar across the street.
places.date: Busy; guides mention a 15–30 minute queue at rush hour.
places.aside: Hard to book for two: guides say it takes bookings only for groups, and there is often a queue.

places.name: Blauw
places.about: Indonesian rijsttafel: many small dishes shared at the table. Often called the reference for rijsttafel in Amsterdam.
places.date: Guides say book about two weeks ahead for weekends.

pick.title: Friday plan: Bistro de la Mer, then Hosokawa
pick.text:
**First choice: Bistro de la Mer.** French seafood on the Utrechtsestraat, with a Michelin star, about €75 for three courses. Guides say it fills three to four weeks ahead for Friday, so ask for 19:30 today: phone +31 20 237 4790.

**If it is full: Hosokawa.** Teppanyaki by the Leidseplein, about €50–80. Sit at the plate and watch the chef. Phone +31 20 638 8086.

**Something different: Blauw.** Indonesian rijsttafel in Oud-Zuid, many small dishes to share. Book about two weeks ahead.

**Set aside:** Yamazato is over budget (kaiseki from about €140); Bird is hard to book for two.

This recorded tour did not check Friday's tables. In the app, an agent opens each booking page, checks 19:30 on Friday 6 November live, and can book the one you choose.
